build_encoder_block: build an EncoderBlock with residual units and downsampling convolution for audio encoding
build_encoder: build an Encoder with multiple EncoderBlocks for hierarchical audio feature extraction and downsampling
build_activate_encoder: build an ActivateEncoder that applies a nonlinear activation on top of the Encoder output
run_encoder_forward: run the Encoder forward pass to encode input audio through convolutional blocks
run_encoder_inference: run the Encoder encode method for inference-mode audio encoding with causal or noncausal processing
